decisions.statement: An accented letter keeps its letter and loses its mark.
An apostrophe closes the gap rather than opening a gap.
A run of anything else becomes one dash.
A stem carries no dash at either end.
The hundred characters a page's slug holds is named here for every minter.
Nothing here shortens a stem, which is done where the stem is minted.

definition: free text folded into the part of a file name a page is found by
